recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future CDSHooksServicePlanDefinition changes should be made in HL7/cds-hooks-clinical-reasoning unless a new CDS work-group decision brings the profile back into FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-18245 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request asking the base specification to define a PlanDefinition profile for a CDS Hooks service, approved as a CDSHooksPlanDefinition profile including the CDS Hooks endpoint extension.
initial_application: Commits 7bcc13fc39 and 99879e4078 applied the request in core by adding and refining source/plandefinition/plandefinition-cdshooks-service-spreadsheet.xml; later source-rework commits converted it into source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-profile-cdshooksserviceplandefinition.xml and PlanDefinition-cdshooks pack source.
additional_context: FHIR-48393 and FHIR-53085 are later Applied/Persuasive R6 CDS decisions moving CDSHooksServicePlanDefinition and related CDS Hooks profiles out of core and into the Using FHIR Clinical Reasoning with CDS Hooks IG. Commit 6abb14540e removed the PlanDefinition CDS Hooks profile source, implementation guide, and pack-list entry from core. Current core narrative points detailed CDS Hooks clinical reasoning guidance to the external IG, which defines StructureDefinition-cdshooksserviceplandefinition.json.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing the core profile would contradict later applied CDS work; the current core source correctly omits the active profile and routes implementers to the IG that now owns it.
